title: Be Careful with Retry – Don't DDoS Your Own System
description: Retry isn't bad. But used the wrong way, you can unintentionally become the “DDoS hacker”... of your own system.
flags: §3.5–3.7: the source jumps from section 2 straight to 3.5 (there are no 3.0–3.4); the author's numbering is kept unchanged.
§5: 'Cách xử lý' rendered as 'How it was handled' to fit the past-tense case study.
